name: MPC Gateway
author: jacob-sabella
summary: One HTTPS address and one login (mpc / mpc until you change it on its Settings page) for every addin's web page. A start page lists the services addins declare (ADDIN_WEB_PORT), each routed behind the password. Runs Caddy beside MPC. Device only by default (reach it through an SSH tunnel); bind=0.0.0.0 opens it to your network.
